subject.title: [Bug] MiniMax Token Plan (Max) broken in sub-agents after v5.22 bootstrap change

question: Should OpenClaw change core behavior for MiniMax Token Plan sub-agent workflows by adding Token Plan-specific provider routing or broader skill inheritance, or keep the current endpoint and AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md sub-agent boundary?
rationale: Source inspection shows the reported behavior crosses an intentional MiniMax endpoint contract and an intentional sub-agent context boundary, so automation cannot safely choose the product/API direction without maintainer intent and live Token Plan proof.

options.title: Verify and Fix Narrow Provider Bug
options.body: Keep the sub-agent bootstrap boundary unchanged, require live Token Plan endpoint proof, and only patch provider/media behavior that is confirmed broken against MiniMax's current contract.

options.title: Add Token Plan Compatibility Mode
options.body: Approve a deliberate Token Plan-specific routing or skill-discovery mode with docs and upgrade tests, accepting a new compatibility surface in core/plugin code.

options.title: Route Office Skills Outside Core
options.body: Keep core as-is for office/PPT/Word/Excel/PDF Token Plan workflows and ask contributors to publish or update a ClawHub skill/plugin package for the `mmx` CLI path.

recommendation.title: Verify and Fix Narrow Provider Bug
recommendation.body: Keep the sub-agent bootstrap boundary unchanged, require live Token Plan endpoint proof, and only patch provider/media behavior that is confirmed broken against MiniMax's current contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved product question centers on whether to relax the sub-agent bootstrap boundary introduced in commit 56308a71447972b3913e9583d190f9038722d4b2.
